pipeline: atomic rename into licensed raw store
git_policy: Never store vendor raw files in git. Commit only compact manifests, object hashes, canonical roots, coverage/gap receipts, and schema versions.

resumability.failed_download: no receipt and no atomic promotion
resumability.integrity: SHA-256 each object plus canonical manifest root

retention.backup: two independently controlled encrypted copies subject to vendor license
retention.redownload: manifest-based only while entitlement remains active
retention.derived_data: daily/lifecycle products may be retained separately after source-root binding

structural_gates: all event and observation timestamps at or before 2026-06-30T23:59:59Z
no unresolved exposed Grade C/X terminal
symbol reuse creates a new instance unless continuity is proven
funding settlement has a funding timestamp and is not predicted_funding_rate
